name: tracker-future
enabledWhen: future.json non-empty (the bot pauses it when future.json is empty and resumes it when a request with a future startAt arrives)
steps: Work only in <wt> for fleet files; the thin routine prompt has already loaded the rules and bots/<me>/state.json.
Pull <queue-clone> (your private queue repo <queue-repo>) and read future.json (a JSON array; every entry has startAt in <timezone>).
For each request whose startAt has passed, move it unchanged into queue.json and remove it from future.json.
If anything moved, resume tracker-loop if it is paused.
Do not check carriers or any other source; this routine only promotes due requests.
Commit and push the queue repo only if a file changed; put the moved ids in the commit message.
If future.json is empty, pause this routine.
Stay silent. Never message the user directly.
Journal every run, skips included, as the thin routine prompt says; the line's read: field must include `routine:tracker-future.json`.
